title: Love and Obedience

questions.question: How does the land Israel is entering differ from Egypt?
options: It drinks water from the rain of heaven
questions.correctAnswer: It drinks water from the rain of heaven
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:10–11 (ESV): "For the land... is not like the land of Egypt... It is a land of hills and valleys, which drinks water by the rain from heaven..."

questions.question: What happened to Dathan and Abiram?
options: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them
questions.correctAnswer: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:6 (ESV): "...how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up..."

questions.question: If Israel obeys, what will God send for the land?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:14 (ESV): "he will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the later rain..."

questions.question: What two choices are set before Israel?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:26 (ESV): "See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse..."

questions.question: Where should the blessing and curse be pronounced?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:29 (ESV): "you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal."

questions.question: What did God do to the army of Egypt and their horses?
options: Made the water of the Red Sea flow over them
questions.correctAnswer: Made the water of the Red Sea flow over them
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:4 (ESV): "...he made the water of the Red Sea flow over them as they pursued after you..."

questions.question: Teaching the children involves talking about the words when?
options: Sitting in the house, walking by the way, lying down, and rising
questions.correctAnswer: Sitting in the house, walking by the way, lying down, and rising
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:19 (ESV): "You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house..."

questions.question: What is the condition for "serving other gods"?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:28 (ESV): "...if you do not obey... but turn aside from the way..."

questions.question: How should one regarding the commandments to "lay them up"?
options: Lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul
questions.correctAnswer: Lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:18 (ESV): "You shall therefore lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul..."

questions.question: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be whose?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:24 (ESV): "Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours..."

questions.question: What are the boundaries given?
options: From the wilderness to Lebanon, and from the Euphrates to the western sea
From the river to the ends of the earth
questions.correctAnswer: From the wilderness to Lebanon, and from the Euphrates to the western sea
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:24 (ESV): "...from the wilderness and Lebanon and from the River, the river Euphrates, to the western sea shall be your territory."

questions.question: Why did Moses say "I am not speaking to your children"?
options: Because they have not known or seen the discipline of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Because they have not known or seen the discipline of the Lord
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:2 (ESV): "And consider today (since I am not speaking to your children who have not known or seen it), consider the discipline of the Lord..."

questions.question: The eyes of the Lord are on the land from when to when?
options: From the beginning of the year to the end of the year
questions.correctAnswer: From the beginning of the year to the end of the year
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:12 (ESV): "...the eyes of the Lord your God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year to the end of the year."

questions.question: If you serve other gods, the anger of the Lord will kindle and He will shut up what?
options: The heavens, so that there be no rain
questions.correctAnswer: The heavens, so that there be no rain
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:17 (ESV): "then the anger of the Lord will be kindled... and he will shut up the heavens, so that there will be no rain..."

questions.question: Where are Mount Gerizim and Mount Ebal located relative to Gilgal?
options: Beyond the Jordan, west of the road, opposite Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh
questions.correctAnswer: Beyond the Jordan, west of the road, opposite Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 11:30 (ESV): "Are they not beyond the Jordan, west of the road... opposite Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?"

key_verse_text: See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse: the blessing, if you obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you today. (ESV)
